review_type: Implementation self-audit with adversarial and independent-oracle software tests; not independent scientific review.

findings.title: Edit notation changed the scientific conclusion
findings.observation: A broad replacement retaining the original primer DNA was classified as disrupted by the original-site model, while a compact edit yielding the same final sequence was observable.
findings.remediation: Added explicitly versioned exact final-sequence rematching with both orientations, multisite products and representation-invariance tests. Legacy remains named and warned, not silently redefined.

findings.title: Aliases could inflate genomic counterexamples
findings.observation: Renamed hypotheses or alternate allele IDs encoding the same final diploid sequence state could be counted as distinct alternatives.
findings.remediation: Compare actual unordered final sequence pairs; label identical local states and exclude them from witnesses in both models.

findings.title: Readout initialization silently assumed complete observation
findings.observation: A new CLI manifest could default to full-insert readout without a deliberate user declaration of actual sequence coverage.
findings.remediation: Require mutually exclusive --full-insert or --read-bases in CLI initialization. Model configuration remains visible.

findings.title: Public API could trust bypassed model validation
findings.observation: Frozen Pydantic instances can still be constructed/copied without validation; the public engine accepted those instances.
findings.remediation: Enable instance revalidation and validate at public computational boundaries, including nested copied models.

findings.title: The missing allele was not fully inspectable in result evidence
findings.observation: An allele with no signal could be named without its complete edit definition in a result/report. Sequence inspection emphasized observed reads rather than the hidden DNA.
findings.remediation: Store every allele edit definition, final length and SHA; emit final sequences through focused witness inspection. Add candidate evidence to HTML.

findings.title: Geometry scan was not a hypothesis-generating workflow
findings.observation: The alpha required manual encoding of useful alternatives; structural scan counters did not establish read/genotype equivalence.
findings.remediation: Add bounded reference-deletion generation, fixed-allele declaration, sequence deduplication, explicit provenance and fail-closed caps; keep geometry scanner separate.

findings.title: Redundant candidate assays could needlessly disable exact optimization
findings.observation: Candidate-count threshold switched to greedy even when many candidates were safely dominated duplicates.
findings.remediation: Perform deterministic objective-preserving dominance reduction and expose removed candidates. Retain impossible-to-separate cases.

findings.title: New schema defaults could invalidate old artifact checksums
findings.observation: Hashing the newly validated model rather than the archived payload would add defaults and change the digest.
findings.remediation: Verify actual archived JSON before migration defaults; old artifacts pass integrity. Require originating executable for exact replay.

findings.title: Release status and source staging were not actual independent publication
findings.observation: The earlier release was staged in an unrelated repository, and current-session GitHub operations cannot create or push a standalone repository.
findings.remediation: Keep DotMatch untouched. Provide a fresh-history publisher with identity, visibility, source and exact-commit CI gates. Record publication as blocked, not completed.

findings.title: Source-distribution contents omitted new regression fixtures
findings.observation: Packaging patterns included Python tests but not their JSON fixtures, workflow files or full documentation/evidence inventory.
findings.remediation: Explicitly include JSON fixtures, documentation JSON, workflows, line-ending rules and release notes. Test the source archive independently.
findings.regression_evidence: MANIFEST.in; source-distribution verification recorded in BUILD_STATUS.md

remaining_scientific_limits: Exact matching is not calibrated PCR performance
No dosage, mosaicism, off-window or single-primer-product model
publication: No new remote write performed; standalone repo lookup returned Not Found and no authenticated write capability was exposed.
